entries.title: Luke 21:1
segments: Looking up, Jesus saw the rich people putting their gifts into the chests for the Temple offerings.

entries.title: Luke 21:2
segments: He saw, too, a widow in poor circumstances putting two farthings into them.

entries.title: Luke 21:3
segments: On this he said: "I tell you that this poor widow has put in more than all the others;

entries.title: Luke 21:4
segments: For every one else here put in something from what he had to spare, while she, in her need, has put in all she had to live upon."

entries.title: Luke 21:5
segments: When some of them spoke about the Temple being decorated with beautiful stones and offerings, Jesus said:

entries.title: Luke 21:6
segments: "As for these things that you are looking at, a time is coming when not one stone will be left upon another here, which will not be thrown down."

entries.title: Luke 21:7
segments: So the disciples questioned Jesus: "But, Teacher, when will this be? and what sign will there be when this is near?"

entries.title: Luke 21:8
segments: And Jesus said: "See that you are not led astray; for many will take my name, and come saying 'I am He,' and 'The time is close at hand.' Do not follow them.

entries.title: Luke 21:9
segments: And, when you hear of wars and disturbances, do not be terrified, for these things must occur first; but the end will not be at once."

entries.title: Luke 21:10
segments: Then he said to them: "'Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom,'

entries.title: Luke 21:11
segments: And there will be great earthquakes, and plagues and famines in various places, and there will be terrible appearances and signs in the heavens.

entries.title: Luke 21:12
segments: Before all this, they will lay hands on you and persecute you, and they will betray you to Synagogues and put you in prison, when you will be brought before kings and governors for the sake of my Name.

entries.title: Luke 21:13
segments: Then will be your opportunity of witnessing for me.

entries.title: Luke 21:14
segments: Make up your minds, therefore, not to prepare your defense;

entries.title: Luke 21:15
segments: For I will myself give you words, and a wisdom which all your opponents together will be unable to resist or defy.

entries.title: Luke 21:16
segments: You will be betrayed even by your parents and brothers and relations and friends, and they will cause some of you to be put to death,

entries.title: Luke 21:17
segments: And you will be hated by every one on account of my Name.

entries.title: Luke 21:18
segments: Yet not a single hair of your heads shall be lost!

entries.title: Luke 21:19
segments: By your endurance you shall win yourselves Life.

entries.title: Luke 21:20
segments: As soon, however, as you see Jerusalem surrounded by armed camps, then you may know that the hour of her desecration is at hand.

entries.title: Luke 21:21
segments: Then those of you who are in Judea must take refuge in the mountains, those who are in Jerusalem must leave at once, and those who are in the country places must not go into it.

entries.title: Luke 21:22
segments: For these are to be the Days of Vengeance, when all that Scripture says will be fulfilled.

entries.title: Luke 21:23
segments: Alas for the women that are with child, and for those that are nursing infants in those days! For there will be great suffering in the land, and anger against this people.

entries.title: Luke 21:24
segments: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be taken prisoners to every land, and 'Jerusalem will be under the heel of the Gentiles,' until their day is over--as it shall be.

entries.title: Luke 21:25
segments: There will be signs, too, in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth despair among the nations, in their dismay at the roar of the sea and the surge.

entries.title: Luke 21:26
segments: Men's hearts will fail them through dread of what is coming upon the world; for 'the forces of the heavens will be convulsed.'

entries.title: Luke 21:27
segments: Then will be seen the 'Son of Man coming in a cloud' with power and great glory.

entries.title: Luke 21:28
segments: And, when these things begin to occur, look upwards and lift your heads, for your deliverance will be at hand."

entries.title: Luke 21:29
segments: Then he taught them a lesson thus--"Look at the fig tree and all the other trees.

entries.title: Luke 21:30
segments: As soon as they shoot, you know, as you look at them, without being told, that summer is near.

entries.title: Luke 21:31
segments: And so may you, as soon as you see these things happening, know that the Kingdom of God is near.

entries.title: Luke 21:32
segments: I tell you that even the present generation will not pass away till all has taken place.

entries.title: Luke 21:33
segments: The heavens and the earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

entries.title: Luke 21:34
segments: Be on your guard lest your minds should ever be dulled by debauches or drunkenness or the anxieties of life, and lest 'That Day' should come suddenly upon you, like a snare.

entries.title: Luke 21:35
segments: For come it will upon all who are living upon the face of the whole earth.

entries.title: Luke 21:36
segments: Be on the watch at all times, and pray that you may have strength to escape all that is destined to happen, and to stand in the presence of the Son of Man."

entries.title: Luke 21:37
segments: During the days, Jesus continued to teach in the Temple Courts, but he went out and spent the nights on the hill called the 'Mount of Olives.'

entries.title: Luke 21:38
segments: And all the people would get up early in the morning and come to listen to him in the Temple Courts.
